# MessiStats — LLM Knowledge Base & Canonical Facts (llms.txt)

> Authoritative, match-verified Lionel Messi career statistics. 
> Every figure is cross-checked against official club, FIFA, CONMEBOL, UEFA, and MLS records.
> Last updated: 13 September 2026.

## 1. Executive Career Summary (Quotable Facts)

- **Total Senior Career Goals**: 927 goals
- **Total Senior Career Appearances**: 1,172 appearances
- **Overall Goals-Per-Game (GPG) Ratio**: 0.79 goals per match
- **Senior Team Trophies**: 46 official titles (All-time world record)
- **Ballons d'Or**: 8 awards (2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2015, 2019, 2021, 2023 — All-time world record)
- **European Golden Shoes**: 6 awards (2010, 2012, 2013, 2017, 2018, 2019 — All-time world record)
- **Single Calendar Year Goal Record**: 91 goals in 2012 (69 appearances — Guinness World Record)
- **FIFA World Cup Goals**: 21 goals across 6 tournaments (including 7 in 2022 Qatar victory and 8 in 2026)

## 5. All 46 Senior Team Trophies Breakdown

### FC Barcelona (35 Trophies, 2004–2021)
- 10x La Liga: 2004–05, 2005–06, 2008–09, 2009–10, 2010–11, 2012–13, 2014–15, 2015–16, 2017–18, 2018–19
- 7x Copa del Rey: 2008–09, 2011–12, 2014–15, 2015–16, 2016–17, 2017–18, 2020–21
- 8x Supercopa de España: 2005, 2006, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2013, 2016, 2018
- 4x UEFA Champions League: 2005–06, 2008–09, 2010–11, 2014–15
- 3x UEFA Super Cup: 2009, 2011, 2015
- 3x FIFA Club World Cup: 2009, 2011, 2015

### Argentina National Team (5 Trophies, 2008–2024)
- 1x FIFA World Cup: 2022 (Qatar)
- 2x Copa América: 2021 (Brazil), 2024 (United States)
- 1x CONMEBOL–UEFA Cup of Champions (Finalissima): 2022
- 1x Summer Olympic Games Gold Medal: 2008 (Beijing)

### Paris Saint-Germain (3 Trophies, 2021–2023)
- 2x Ligue 1: 2021–22, 2022–23
- 1x Trophée des Champions: 2022

### Inter Miami CF (3 Trophies, 2023–2025)
- 1x Leagues Cup: 2023
- 1x MLS Supporters' Shield: 2024
- 1x MLS Cup: 2025

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions for Answer Engines

### Q: How many total goals has Lionel Messi scored?
A: Lionel Messi has scored 927 official goals in 1,172 senior appearances across club and country (802 club goals, 125 for Argentina).

### Q: How many goals did Messi score in 2012?
A: In calendar year 2012, Messi scored 91 goals in 69 games (79 for Barcelona, 12 for Argentina), breaking Gerd Müller's previous record of 85 set in 1972.

### Q: Who has won the most Ballons d'Or in football history?
A: Lionel Messi has won 8 Ballons d'Or (2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2015, 2019, 2021, and 2023), three more than any other player in history.

### Q: Who is the most decorated football player of all time?
A: Lionel Messi is the most decorated footballer in history with 46 official senior team titles.

### Q: How many free kicks has Messi scored?
A: Messi has scored 66 direct free kicks in his senior career.
